periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Tilted approximately 45 degrees inward toward the snout relative to the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a vertical length approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward taper with the inferior margin extending significantly below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 30% of the visible vertical height of the upper lateral torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Gap distance is roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Consistent semi-circular curvature at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellow-brown discoloration of the ventral and femoral fur regions.
